units.text: EXT. FRONT-LINE TRENCH, FLANDERS - DAWN (1916)
Mud to the knee.
A duckboard path vanishes into fog.
Somewhere, rifle fire pops like distant twigs.
CORPORAL ALISTAIR BRODIE, thirty, sits on an ammunition crate with a chessboard balanced on a sandbag.
Across from him PRIVATE EMMANUEL DUBOIS, twenty, a French-Canadian volunteer, rubs a pawn between finger and thumb.
Your move.
units.name: BRODIE

units.text: I know.
units.name: DUBOIS

units.text: Neither moves.
A shell whistles overhead and bursts a hundred yards away.
They flinch together, hunch, and glance up, then back at the board.
Dust sifts from the revetment onto the pieces.
Brodie blows it off.
Dubois nudges his bishop forward with a trembling hand.
Good.
units.name: BRODIE

units.text: Is it?
units.name: DUBOIS

units.text: Brodie takes the bishop with a knight.
Dubois stares at the empty square.
Neither speaks.
Then Dubois reaches into his tunic, draws out a creased photograph, and sets it on the board beside the captured piece.
Who's that?
units.name: BRODIE

units.text: My sister.
units.name: DUBOIS

units.text: Brodie looks at it for a long moment.
He lifts his own king, tips it on its side, and lays it next to the photograph.
